Job no: 943745

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Allied and Scientific Health, Nursing-Midwifery




 

Central Adelaide Local Health Network (CALHN)

Royal Adelaide Hospital, Integrated Care

RN1 $77,824 to $106,187 p.a + super + salary packaging

AHP1 $73,710 to $89,981 p.a + super + salary packaging

Full time temporary contract until June 2027

About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

As a Triage Delegate with the Statewide Aged Care Assessment Service (ACAS), you will play a vital role in supporting aged clients through the intake and triage process. You will manage incoming referrals, using the Integrated Assessment Tool (IAT) and My Aged Care client records to determine eligibility and clinical priority for a comprehensive assessment. This includes accurately entering data into the My Aged Care system and providing clients with clear information on available aged care pathways. Whether it's community care, residential respite, or flexible care options, you will guide clients through their choices and ensure they receive the services most appropriate for their needs.

In this dynamic role, you'll engage with clients, their families, carers, and a range of health professionals, ensuring a seamless and compassionate service. You will be responsible for adhering to the Aged Care Assessment Programme guidelines, meeting key performance indicators (KPIs), and participating in educational and quality assurance activities. By aligning with legislative and funding requirements under the Aged Care Act 2024, you will contribute to the continual improvement of services in line with SA Health's Aged Care Strategy, making a real difference in the lives of South Australians.

About You

You are a compassionate health professional who enjoys helping older people access the right care at the right time. With strong assessment skills and a collaborative approach, you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your expertise supports positive outcomes for clients, carers and the broader community.

- Registered Nurse or Allied Health qualification with registration
- Experience in aged care, My Aged Care and client assessment
- Strong communication, teamwork and stakeholder engagement skills
- Knowledge of aged care legislation, client pathways and reforms

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter
We know that a great career is about more than just the work you do, it's also about the support you receive. At CALHN, you'll enjoy :

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Safe connections - be part of a culture of safety and connectivity, focusing on outcomes and continuous improvements

Recognition & growth - celebrate success and explore opportunities across CALHN's many sites

Flexible work options - speak to us about flexibility options for this role to suit your lifestyle

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

Health & fitness perks - discounted access to Fitness Passport & free flu vaccinations

Wellbeing support - Employee Assistance Program for you & your family

Diversity & Inclusion
We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, culturally diverse backgrounds, and LGBTQIA+ communities.

Application Information

Please refer to the role description for essential educational-vocational qualifications that may be required

RN RD: 943745 RN Triage Delegate, Aged Care Assessment Servic RD.pdf

Appointment will be subject to satisfactory Criminal History Clearances and compliant immunisation screening as indicated in the role description.

We're dedicated to providing person-centred care, advancing research, and fostering education and training across all disciplines.

Our services are structured by geographic areas and age groups - child & adolescent, adult, and older persons - and are supported by skilled multidisciplinary teams including psychiatrists, registrars, allied health, nurses, and administrative staff. Salaries are dependent on skills & experience -
•	Bruce Rock, WA, 6418 -  From $85,000 
•	Forrestfield, WA, 6058 - From $79,500 
•	Geraldton, WA, 6530 - From $85,000

These positions are -

•	ASAP Start !

The key responsibilities for these roles include: 
•	Servicing and maintenance of trucks and trailers, as per client requirements
•	Trailer/truck assembly
•	Interpreting drawings and procedures.
•	Working on braking systems including ABS/EBS systems
•	Working with truck/trailer electrical, air and hydraulic systems
•	Working on hydraulics and PTO systems used in tippers and side tippers
•	Re-setting wheel alignment using modern 3D camera equipment

Required skills and experience: 
•	Any mechanical Trade Certification preferred - LV / HV / Fitters are encouraged to apply.
•	For non-Trade Certified applicants, 2-3 years experience required working on similar equipment.
•	Forklift ticket (high risk licence)

About the Company:
Bruce Rock Engineering is a leading quality designer, builder and service provider of road transport equipment in Australia. We offer a complete range of trailer solutions to the agricultural, mining, construction and general freight industries nationwide. With the lightest tare weights in Australia, our innovative, high quality trailers are engineered for reliability, durability and performance.

Why work for Bruce Rock Engineering?
•	Great family-based values driven culture.
•	Join a growing, exciting, and professional business with opportunity for growth & career development.
•	Internal movement and progression across 4 sites around WA (Forrestfield, Bruce Rock, Port Hedland, and Geraldton).
•	Regular team BBQ's and active social club.
